assertions: Built ESM entry loads local female GLB, creates nonzero canvas, obtains WebGL2 and resolves public ready promise.
User click resumes synthetic 48kHz AudioContext, attaches audio stream, runs AudioWorklet capture and bundled viseme model, and receives timed viseme events.
Public detachStream clears capture/timeline while preserving caller-owned source track.
Reattaching the caller-owned stream restarts capture and model events.
Public setAvatar swaps to locally bundled male GLB with active audio stream.
Calling dispose twice removes canvas, detaches stream and closes SDK AudioContext; harness also stops its own oscillator/track/context.
Model and both avatars return local HTTP 200; no external asset/service request and no uncaught page/SDK error.
